sloka: विषसाद पुनर्भुयो लुलितव्याकुलेन्ध्रियः ।तत्रतां पतितां भूमौ शयानामतथोचिताम् ॥२-१०-२२॥
transliteration: viṣasāda punarbhuyo lulitavyākulendhriyaḥ ।tatratāṁ patitāṁ bhūmau śayānāmatathocitām ॥2-10-22॥

translations.english: The lord of the earth (Dasaratha) saw her (Kaikeyi) lying down on the floor of the chamber of wrath in an unbecoming manner and felt as if consumed by grief.
